builds.name: Reference: Ranked bot core
builds.goal: Reference for Samira: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ bot players use most (14,644 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 56.9% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A close-range combo marksman who alternates distinct hits to reach S style, then channels a crit-capable area ultimate. Allied immobilization and dash resets help create access. The current adc provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: The Collector → Infinity Edge → Lord Dominik's Regards. Conqueror keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Gluttonous Greaves, Bloodthirster, Guardian Angel.
builds.summary: The proven bot baseline: The Collector → Infinity Edge → Lord Dominik's Regards, with Conqueror.
testPlan: Play it in bot as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (The Collector → Infinity Edge → Lord Dominik's Regards) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 56.9% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: The Collector → Infinity Edge → Lord Dominik's Regards.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

If an enemy champion is killed within 3 seconds of Samira damaging them, This Ability's Cooldown is reset.

Samira can only use this Ability if her current Style rating is S. Using this Ability consumes all Style rating.

Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her 10 times over 2 seconds, each shot dealing [20 / 40 / 60 + (0.3) × AD] physical damage and applying Life Steal at [100]% effectiveness. Each shot can also critically strike.

Samira fires a shot, dealing [0 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage to the first enemy hit.

If this Ability is cast towards an enemy in melee range, Samira will instead slash with her sword, dealing [0 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage.

Samira builds a combo by dealing damage with Attacks or Abilities against enemy champions unique from the previous one. Each one increases her Style, from "E" to "S" grade (6 total). Samira gains @MSBonusNew@ Move Speed per grade.

Samira's Attacks and Abilities in melee range deal an additional [(0.1) × AD + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=1, changes=[])] magic damage, increased up to @EmpoweredMeleeDamageTooltip@ based on the target's missing Health.

builds.name: Inferno lifesteal armor shred
builds.summary: Test inferno lifesteal armor shred against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test inferno lifesteal armor shred against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Inferno Trigger explicitly applies lifesteal at 100% effectiveness and its ten physical shots can crit; Bloodthirster plus Visage tests survival during the two-second channel. Cleaver supports physical damage, while Essence Reaver keeps one Spellblade available during style-building attacks.
testPlan: Required state: Build S with distinct attacks/abilities before entering R range.
Measure R healing versus one and multiple champions at equal health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: CC interrupts R and missing damage prevents the E takedown reset.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: R lifesteal does not imply every shot applies all basic-attack on-hits.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Bloodthirster, Black Cleaver, Spirit Visage, Infinity Edge, Essence Reaver, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Physical matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Samira: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A close-range combo marksman who alternates distinct hits to reach S style, then channels a crit-capable area ultimate. Allied immobilization and dash resets help create access. Reach S style through valid distinct hits before R. Ultimate crit compatibility does not remove interruption or melee access risks; shield/defense slots can buy the only usable channel. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Samira: Reach S style through valid distinct hits before R. Ultimate crit compatibility does not remove interruption or melee access risks; shield/defense slots can buy the only usable channel.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.

The route fails Samira's stated kit question: Reach S style through valid distinct hits before R. Ultimate crit compatibility does not remove interruption or melee access risks; shield/defense slots can buy the only usable channel.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.goal: Test style health-to-ad diver against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Melee Daredevil Impulse adds AD-scaled magic damage at low target health while Q/R remain largely physical; Bloodmail supplies health-linked AD and Shojin supports building style with distinct spells. Eclipse and Death's Dance help reach an actual first takedown for E reset.
testPlan: Required state: Alternate distinct style inputs and fight inside melee bonus range.
Compare time to S and survival through first R against a crit build.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: No crit or lifesteal sharply weakens the standard R carry pattern.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Rapid repeated Q alone does not grant six distinct style grades.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
